Amendment No. 1: Citizenship Requirement to Vote in West Virginia Elections Amendment

measures.questionText: Amendment No. 1: Citizenship Requirement to Vote in West Virginia Elections Amendment Summary of Purpose: This amendment provides that in all elections held in West Virginia only citizens of the United States who are citizens of this state are qualified to vote.

provenance.quote: Amendment No. 1: Citizenship Requirement to Vote in West Virginia Elections Amendment Summary of Purpose: This amendment provides that in all elections held in West Virginia only citizens of the United States who are citizens of this state are qualified to vote.

coverageNotes: The Secretary of State links a 2026 General Candidate Listing at https://candidates.wvsos.gov/, which returned HTTP 503 during this acquisition. Candidates were converted from the Secretary of State’s official November 3, 2026 sample ballots for all 55 counties. The sample-ballot index says “Please select your county.” All U.S. Senate, both U.S. House, all 100 House of Delegates districts, all 17 State Senate districts and the unexpired Senate District 3 and District 17 contests are represented; The statewide certified candidate list was not acquired. The sample ballots give party abbreviations, which are preserved as printed, and state no candidate websites or incumbency.

The official sample ballots acquired across all counties list one statewide constitutional amendment and no statewide executive or statewide judicial contest for this election. County, municipal and district judicial contests are outside this package.

Printed name variation for FOR MEMBER OF HOUSE OF DELEGATES, district 40: JENNIFER GILKERSON in Monroe and JENNIFER LEA GILKERSON in Summers. The saved candidacy preserves the name printed in its cited sample ballot.
